meta.title: Exemption categories the desk can propose
meta.note: Every proposal is a suggestion for a human reviewer. Nothing is withheld or redacted until a named reviewer approves it.

employee_contact.label: Employee home address, home or personal cell number, birthdate

personal_privacy.label: Personal information in personnel, medical or similar files (unwarranted invasion of privacy)
personal_privacy.note: There is no general 'PII' exemption in the CPRA. The reviewer must confirm the record type and the privacy balance.

draft.label: Preliminary draft or note not retained in the ordinary course
draft.note: Applies only if not retained in the ordinary course and the interest in withholding clearly outweighs disclosure.

deliberative.label: Deliberative process, asserted under the public-interest balancing test
deliberative.note: Deliberative process is not an express CPRA exemption. It is argued under § 7922.000 and case law. Attorney review needed.

security.label: Information security record that would reveal vulnerabilities
